split_policy: Reuse the archived split; scoring drives search, published outer test is a development diagnostic because its results have already been inspected

retrieval.adaptive_search: Reselect from a frozen bank each round using retained formulas, scoring feedback and optional model queries; no new full-index retrieval within a trajectory

generation.policy: Same output budget for all modes; retry an incomplete length-terminated response with an expanded budget, never select between completed generations

tree_transfer: Freeze ANN-selected formulas and evaluate native14 and all-raw HGB with no test reselection
pilot_decision: Review evidence relevance, graph use, invalid formula rate, actual context length and scoring gains before a larger comparison; do not select a method version using test ranking
